input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I haven’t been able to send those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called—for a few hours now. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you also need my date of birth, or is that enough?
It looks like my phone currently shows no signal and that mobile data is turned off. Also, my messaging app says it can’t send MMS messages right now. What should I do next?

My phone says that Airplane Mode is off, but it also mentions that there’s no SIM card detected and no cellular service. Mobile data and data roaming are both enabled, though. What does that mean? Is there something I should do about the SIM card?
Alright, I’ve just reinserted the SIM card. Now my phone shows a strong signal, 5G, and that mobile data is enabled at the top. What should I do next? Will this help with sending picture messages?
It still says my messaging app can’t send MMS messages. Is there something else I should try? I’m starting to get a bit worried—will I be able to send pictures again soon?

I checked, and my phone’s APN settings show the APN name as “internet” and the MMSC URL as “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” Is that correct, or do I need to change anything there? What should I do next?
It looks like Wi-Fi Calling is turned off on my phone. Does that mean it’s not causing the problem? What should I try next?
The messaging app I use is just called “messaging.” Is that the information you need to check its permissions?
Yes, please! I’m not very good with these things, so step-by-step instructions would be helpful. I get nervous about changing settings—will this mess up anything else on my phone or my photos?
I checked, and it looks like my messaging app only has permission for "phone" right now—not storage or SMS. Should I go ahead and allow those permissions? Will you walk me through it if I get stuck?

I’ve just allowed both storage and SMS permissions for my messaging app, but it still says I can’t send MMS messages. Is there anything else I can try? I’m starting to feel a bit frustrated—will this ever work again?

I’m not sure what you mean by “lines”—I only use this one phone with my number, 555-123-2002. Could you check the network mode for this number? If you need to check for all lines, please let me know what I should do. Sorry if I’m not understanding!
It looks like my phone is set to “4G/5G preferred” for the network mode. Is that the right setting for sending MMS, or do I need to change it? What should I do next?
I restarted my phone like you suggested, but I still can’t send MMS messages. I’m getting a bit anxious—what else can we try? I really need to send these pictures.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.
